heading: Monday, July 27, 2026
topLine: Neurosurgery resident proves Crouzeix's conjecture with GPT-5.6 Sol.

items.headline: Neurosurgery resident proves Crouzeix's conjecture with GPT-5.6 Sol
items.summary: Shanmu Jin, a neurosurgery resident at Peking Union Medical College Hospital, posted a proof that the numerical range of a matrix is a 2-spectral set, settling Crouzeix's 2004 conjecture. He said the key theorem came from a roughly 16-hour autonomous GPT-5.6 Sol run. Anne Greenbaum, Alex Townsend and Michel Crouzeix checked the proof and believe it is correct. On 4 August, Emiel Lorist and Felix Schwenninger posted an independent short proof, disclosing that they used ChatGPT 5.6 to explore strategies.
